text:
Tom and Katie are arguing about the size of the marked angle.
Tom says it is 150°
Katie says it is 210°
Who is correct?  (A) Only Tom  (B) Only Katie  (C) Both Tom and Katie  (D) Neither is correct
visual_description: A semicircular protractor is placed with its centre at the angle vertex. One ray points to the right along the 0° line, and the other ray points up-left, aligning with about 150° on the outer scale. The marked angle is shaded orange below/outside the protractor between the two rays, indicating the larger reflex angle.
